name: Cumilla
summary: A historic city known for the Buddhist ruins at Mainamati, rasamalai sweets, khadi cloth and the Dhormosagar pond.
season_note: Winter is dry and pleasant for ruins. Monsoon is wet but manageable.

reach.how: AC and non-AC buses from Dhaka (Sayedabad, Gulistan) to Cumilla
reach.note: Traffic around Dhaka can add time.

reach.how: Intercity trains from Kamalapur to Cumilla

local.note: Useful for Mainamati and Salban Vihara.

attractions.name: Dhormosagar
attractions.what: A large old pond at the town centre with walking paths.
attractions.tip: Visit at evening when it is lively.

attractions.name: Commonwealth War Cemetery
attractions.what: A carefully kept cemetery for soldiers of World War II.

attractions.name: Matri Bhandar (rasamalai)
attractions.what: Famous place to taste Cumilla rasamalai.
attractions.tip: Buy fresh; carry a box home.

attractions.name: Khadi cloth shop
attractions.what: Hand-woven khadi cloth, a local craft.

attractions.name: Mainamati museum and ruins
attractions.what: Day trip to the Buddhist ruins nearby (see Mainamati).

budget.area: Simple hotel near the town centre

rules: Do not pick items from the archaeological site.
